query_plan_requirements: Measure real old/new combined and detail readers on populated valid synthetic horses and mixed ordinary/horse pages. Previous 12000-listing benchmark had an empty horse fixture and is not horse-volume evidence.

Correlate any new eligibility lookup directly with candidate h.identity_id; reject unrestricted account/identity eligibility scans and all-account caches. Do not assume LATERAL/Memoize from ordinary data transfers without measurement.
Include 20000 unrelated identities/accounts and selective horse identity, offer-type/keyword and detail cases; count account helper invocations as transaction deltas, not unflushed global counters.
Observe existing publication-finality/snapshot/gallery cost as well as new account helper cost. Keep is_public/has_current_publication unchanged.

horse_offers_search_vector_idx indexes search_vector; current public horse search uses a different explicit to_tsvector expression. Do not claim that this GIN supports that predicate or switch expressions in this permission-only module.
Preserve existing EE/EUR, five-type, wanted location/price, FTS allowlist, hidden-provider, author-block, chronology, exact count and pagination contracts.
Keep known combined ordinary wide-search cost as a separate required optimization before traffic/content scale; one-client synthetic plans do not prove millions throughput.
